proposals.announcement_evidence: Mk21A technology maturation and risk reduction (TMRR) research and development for reentry vehicles (RVs)
proposals.rationale: The announcement names the Mk21A reentry vehicle by designator and describes exactly the phase the RDT&E line funds: technology maturation and risk reduction, a prototype flight-test plan, and 'development of two prototype RVs with telemetry capability in order to further mature technology', paid with 'fiscal 2020 research, development, test and evaluation funds'. The index carries 'The Mk21A Reentry Vehicle (RV)' under PE 0101328F (ICBM Reentry Vehicles, doc 412, AF RDT&E), so appropriation and life-cycle phase both match the line rather than merely the platform. The index also carries 'Mk21A Reentry Vehicle' under procurement BLI MK21A0 (doc 410), but that is the production twin of the same program and the announcement's RDT&E money and TMRR scope select the development line; I propose only the RDT&E PE.

refute_a.reason: The full paragraph states 'Fiscal 2020 research, development, test and evaluation funds are being used' on a cost-type TMRR modification building two prototype RVs — RDT&E money and development-phase scope against an RDT&E PE, with the Mk21A the article being developed rather than a platform the contract merely supports; 'ICBM Reentry Vehicles' carries three named RV programs and is not a rollup, and the procurement twin MK21A0 is excluded by the RDT&E money color rather than competing for it.

refute_b.reason: The name does collide - 'Mk21A Reentry Vehicle' sits under procurement BLI MK21A0 (doc 410, line 1095) as well as under 0101328F (line 57) - but the evidence does not fit the twin equally: 'technology maturation and risk reduction (TMRR) research and development', 'two prototype RVs' and 'fiscal 2020 research, development, test and evaluation funds' can only be the development line, and no third index row owns the Mk21A designator (0603851F carries RVAP, not Mk21A).

proposals.program_name: LGM-30G Flight Test Telemetry and Termination System (FT3)

proposals.announcement_evidence: Apex Gear Drive: Air Plan Environment for Execution, Gaming, Exploration, Assessment, and Refinement
proposals.rationale: The announcement spells the program's name out in full - 'Apex Gear Drive: Air Plan Environment for Execution, Gaming, Exploration, Assessment, and Refinement' - which is the expansion of APEX GEAR, the name the index carries under PE 0603032F (Future AF Integrated Technology Demos, doc 412) as 'Vanguard Prospect - APEX GEAR'. refute_a.reason: The archived paragraph completes the truncated fund line as 'Fiscal 2025 Air Force research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $397,085 are being obligated' with the Air Force Research Laboratory, Rome, New York as contracting activity — RDT&E money on a cost-plus-fixed-fee completion contract delivering 'an integrated prototype', which is precisely the 6.3 demonstration work this PE funds; the PE names APEX GEAR as its own prospect rather than aggregating unrelated content, and no platform stands between the contract and the program.

proposals.announcement_evidence: Counter Communication System Meadowlands development
proposals.rationale: Meadowlands is the CCS upgrade, and the announcement's own words name the program - 'Counter Communication System Meadowlands development' - with the work described as design change plus operator and remote operations suites, performed at the Space Force sites (Cape Canaveral, Vandenberg, Colorado Springs) where CCS is fielded. The index carries this program twice under the same program title 'Counterspace Systems': 'Counter Satellite Communications System (CCS)' under RDT&E PE 1206421SF (doc 417) and 'The Counter Communications System (CCS)' under procurement BLI CTRSPC (doc 416); I propose the RDT&E line because the announcement calls the effort 'development' and the only fully stated appropriation is 'Fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,704,595'. The collision with CTRSPC is real and is the thing to break this on - the record's second, truncated fund citation may be procurement, in which case the sibling line is the better owner.

refute_a.reason: The archived paragraph's full fund line is 'Fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,704,595; and fiscal 2024 procurement funds in the amount of $30,792,015', so 92% of the obligation is procurement money, and the described work — a fixed-price-incentive contract that 'will procure instructor managed training suites, remote operations suites, and additional spares' — is procurement of fielded hardware, not the RDT&E line's own development; the index carries the procurement twin 'The Counter Communications System (CCS)' under BLI CTRSPC (doc 416), which owns the bulk of this action, so attributing it to 1206421SF overstates the claim.

proposals.announcement_evidence: protected tactical service field demonstration (PTSFD)
proposals.rationale: The award is the Protected Tactical Service field demonstration, the risk-reduction step of the PTS program itself rather than support to something else: it will 'demonstrate the ability to provide wideband anti-jam communications to tactical users', it is cost-plus-incentive-fee, it is bought by the Space and Missile Systems Center, and 'fiscal 2016 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $11,000,000' are obligated - RDT&E money against an RDT&E PE. The announcement also mentions the Wideband Global SATCOM constellation, but that is the transport the demonstration rides on - a platform the contract uses, not the program it funds - so no WGS proposal is made. The exposure a refute lens should weigh is the date: a 2016 award against the Space Force PE that carries PTS today, after the AF-to-SF PE renumbering.

refute_a.reason: 'Fiscal 2016 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $11,000,000 are being obligated' — RDT&E money against an RDT&E PE whose program title is literally 'Protected Tactical Service (PTS)', and PTSFD is that program's own risk-reduction field demonstration rather than support to something else; the Wideband Global SATCOM constellation appears only as the transport the demonstration rides on and is correctly not proposed, and the PE carries five named PTS elements rather than being a catch-all.

MAJE) could match the anti-jam description but own no part of the name, so no other index line claims this identity.

proposals.announcement_evidence: Small Diameter Bomb Increment I miniature munition for Foreign Military Sales countries
proposals.rationale: The program is named unambiguously - Small Diameter Bomb Increment I, i.e. the GBU-39 the index carries under BLI SDB000 - but the evidence does not reach the attribution the published claim makes. The action is a ceiling increase on an IDIQ for 'integration, sustainment and support ... for Foreign Military Sales countries', with the modification explicitly a ceiling raise and the buyers a list of thirteen partner nations 'and any other future country'. Foreign military sales are funded by the purchasing country, not by the US SDB000 procurement line, and the scope is integration and sustainment services rather than the line's own munition buy, so the award does not show that it paid for this BLI's work.

proposals.announcement_evidence: Small Diameter Bomb I (SDB-I) sustainment and titled contractor logistics support

proposals.announcement_evidence: enable essential new enterprise capabilities supporting the Air Force Network

proposals.announcement_evidence: custodial services for Hill Air Force Base, Little Mountain Test Annex, and the Oasis facility at the Utah Test and Training Range (UTTR)
proposals.rationale: The Little Mountain Test Annex is carried in the index as 'Little Mountain Test Facility (LMTF)' under PE 0101213F (and again under BLI 00099L), so a name match exists - and it is exactly the trap §3 rejects. The award is an IDIQ for custodial services, i.e. cleaning, at Hill AFB, Little Mountain and the UTTR Oasis facility, funded with fiscal 2018 operations and maintenance money; the facility is merely where the janitorial work happens.
